C0808.title: 2022 npm Ecosystem wsrcsv Backdoor Trojan Distribution Incident
C0808.summary: In October 2022, the Tianwen platform detected that a user named nsrvmzuq uploaded 152 packages to the npm ecosystem. Most of these package names closely resembled popular packages, constituting a typosquatting attack. All malicious packages ultimately dropped the wsrcsv.exe backdoor, posing a severe security threat to downstream users.

references.title: Tianwen: 2022 Annual Review of npm Ecosystem Software Supply Chain Attacks | Star Map Lab
